headline: Turkey's Havelsan Signs Defense Cooperation Deal in Nigeria
summary: Turkish defense firm Havelsan signed a memorandum of understanding with the Defence Industries Corporation of Nigeria to explore joint technology projects.
why: Havelsan is a major Turkish state-linked defense technology and software provider. Defense pacts between emerging economies reflect expanding south-south industrial cooperation.
